title: Charred corn and brown rice salad with feta

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Rice, corn cobs, olive oil, tomatoes, spring onions, feta, lemon, basil and smoked paprika are all ordinary home ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a saucepan, a heavy frying pan and a sieve, and slicing kernels off a cob is within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: 250g brown rice, four cobs, 250g tomatoes and 200g feta make a sound salad for four, and the cooking times and dressing are sensible.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes of charring, slicing and dressing fits while the rice boils for its 30 minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A charred sweetcorn salad suits an August lunch, and the corn is clearly the heart of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English a neighbour would follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholegrain rice, vegetables and feta make a filling, balanced lunch a family would happily eat again.
